description: FSH3 pocket radial profile and cavity-volume ranking across the comparator panel
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
sh=pd.read_csv('fsh3_pocket_shells.csv')
df=pd.read_csv('fsh3_pocket_comparison.csv')
print(sh.to_string(index=False))
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(sh['shell_from_Ser117_OG_A'],sh['sub_volume_A3'],color='#c53030',alpha=.85)
for i,r in sh.iterrows():
    ax.text(i,r['sub_volume_A3']+40,str(int(r['sub_volume_A3'])),ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('distance shell from Ser117 OG ($\\AA$)'); ax.set_ylabel('cavity sub-volume ($\\AA^3$)')
ax.set_title('FSH3 pocket is widest 8-12 $\\AA$ from the nucleophile',fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0,1900)
ax=axes[1]
o=df.sort_values('pocket_vol_A3')
col=['#c53030' if s.startswith('FSH3') else ('#9467bd' if s.startswith(('OVCA2','FSH1')) else '#4c78a8') for s in o['structure']]
ax.barh(o['structure'],o['pocket_vol_A3'].fillna(0),color=col)
ax.set_xlabel('cavity volume at the catalytic Ser ($\\AA^3$)')
ax.set_title('FSH3 model cavity is the largest in the panel,\nbut LPLA2 (diacyl-PC) is the smallest: size is not diagnostic',fontsize=11)
for i,(s,v) in enumerate(zip(o['structure'],o['pocket_vol_A3'])):
    ax.text((0 if np.isnan(v) else v)+30,i,'no pocket' if np.isnan(v) else str(int(v)),va='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
